name: Kashima Shizuru
source:
Grade: 2nd year, Sakura Group
Affiliation: Art Club

Shizuru is one of [url=/c13087]Akiko's[/url] friends as well as her classmate. She's kind of the silent and clever type, but she's a little weird sometimes and she ain't what she seems. Shizuru's an excellent artist, but that’s to artists though. 

[Edited from [url=http://accany.wordpress.com/2009/05/31/花と乙女に祝福を-review/]Accany's review[/url]]
